incident: MediaPipe VIDEO timestamps reset to zero between independent sample timelines while one FaceLandmarker instance was reused.

evidence.outcome: MediaPipe VIDEO processing completed; 204 frames decoded.
ValueError: Input timestamp must be monotonically increasing.
ValueError: Input timestamp must be monotonically increasing.

cause: The VIDEO-mode task preserves timestamp monotonicity state for the lifetime of a FaceLandmarker instance. Each sample has its own frozen presentation timeline beginning at t0=0, so reusing one instance across samples is invalid.
repair: Create and close one FaceLandmarker instance per frozen sample. Keep MediaPipe 0.10.35, the same official task model/hash, VIDEO mode, num_faces=1, blendshape output, and actual presentation PTS in milliseconds unchanged.
retry_scope: Rerun only the exact three frozen A0 samples to produce a coherent complete artifact set.

nonblocking_warning.message: stable-ts emitted a Whisper compatibility warning because openai-whisper has a direct_url.json entry.
nonblocking_warning.evidence: whisper.__version__ and installed distribution are 20250625; direct_url.json records the hash-verified openai_whisper-20250625.tar.gz installed from the project-local package archive. stable-ts checks only whether direct_url.json is nonempty before describing it as a repository installation.
nonblocking_warning.interpretation: The warning's installation-source heuristic does not establish a version mismatch. The frozen official PyPI sdist SHA-256 and the 2.19.1 interface qualification already match. The frozen align call was not changed or suppressed.
